meta.heights: from each structure's rail: box 1.0 m below, 6.6 m above (RER sizes, 25 kV); trough and at grade 0.8 m track bed, 5.8 m clear above; viaduct 1.6 m to the arch underside (Deck rule), 5.8 m clear above
meta.structure_types: st: embankment (k fill; the CUT fan W 9th to W Liberty, the north trunk fill, the intercity and C&O descents), arch (k viaduct; the south approach to the Cardinal crossing, the north arch viaduct) or viaduct (normal). gaps: the street openings on an embankment or arch viaduct along the line [c0, c1, street]; a line in the open crosses only inside one (Ben, 26 October)
notes: Lower-pair levels rebuilt from the Deck dive figures (Ben, 26 October: until the Deck publishes a level per point)
Norwood levels approximate, from the ground data (North Viaduct Plan)
W 8th ramp ends and the Bank and Findlay ramps are drawing values
